|notes=The historical Holotable composite says ‘During your deploy phase’. Both publisher slips and the archived full card say ‘During your turn’. The [[Rebel Tech (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Rebel Tech (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006. [[:File:Holotable-OVS3-Rebel-Tech-v17.gif|Historical Holotable composite]].
